system.description: Each level attunes one element (of eight) among spells you know; its fey effect rides those spells free: air lifts an ally into flight for a turn, bolt lets an ally act right after you, fire adds a burn next turn, ice shields an ally for −5 damage, poison poisons — and dark, earth and light each deny one action type (Ranged, Melee, Spell) for the target's next turn.
